content.json:
## 🖥️ VM Right-Sizing — CPU & Memory Utilization

Identify **over-provisioned virtual machines** that are candidates for downsizing, based on CPU and memory utilization over the selected time range.

**Right-sizing logic:** a VM is a *Downsize candidate* when its **average CPU AND average memory are both below the threshold** set below (default 40%). A VM whose **P95 (peak) CPU or memory reaches 80%+** is flagged *Consider upsizing*. Everything else is *Right-sized*.

**Which grid do I read?** VMs send data to one of two tables depending on the monitoring agent. **Step 1** below tells you which one your VMs use — then read the matching grid (**2a** for `Perf`, **2b** for VM Insights). By default all accessible subscriptions and workspaces are analyzed.

---

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query:
resourcecontainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions'
| project value = strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), label = name
| order by label asc

parameters.name: Workspaces
parameters.label: Log Analytics workspace(s)
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces'
| project value = id, label = name
| order by label asc

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (Perf | summarize Records = count(), VMs = dcount(Computer) | extend ["Data source"] = "Perf  (legacy Log Analytics agent / custom Perf DCR)"),
    (InsightsMetrics | where Origin == "vm.azm.ms" | summarize Records = count(), VMs = dcount(Computer) | extend ["Data source"] = "InsightsMetrics  (VM Insights / Azure Monitor Agent)")
| project ["Data source"], VMs, Records
| order by Records desc
content.title: Step 1 · Telemetry availability — which table your VMs report to

content.json: > Read the grid whose **Data source** shows VMs above. If **Perf** has 0 VMs but **InsightsMetrics** has VMs, your fleet uses the Azure Monitor Agent — use **grid 2b**. If neither has VMs, the selected workspaces aren't receiving VM performance telemetry yet.

content.query:
let cpuThreshold = {CPUThreshold};
let memThreshold = {MemThreshold};
let cpu = Perf
| where ObjectName in ("Processor", "Processor Information") and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(CounterValue), 1), P95CPU = round(percentile(CounterValue, 95), 1), MaxCPU = round(max(CounterValue), 1) by Computer;
let mem = Perf
| where ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName in ("% Committed Bytes In Use", "% Used Memory")
| summarize AvgMem = round(avg(CounterValue), 1), P95Mem = round(percentile(CounterValue, 95), 1), MaxMem = round(max(CounterValue), 1) by Computer;
cpu
| join kind=leftouter (mem) on Computer
| extend Recommendation = case(
    AvgCPU < cpuThreshold and (isempty(AvgMem) or AvgMem < memThreshold), "Downsize candidate",
    P95CPU >= 80 or P95Mem >= 80, "Consider upsizing",
    "Right-sized")
| project Computer, ["Avg CPU %"] = AvgCPU, ["P95 CPU %"] = P95CPU, ["Max CPU %"] = MaxCPU, ["Avg Mem %"] = AvgMem, ["P95 Mem %"] = P95Mem, ["Max Mem %"] = MaxMem, Recommendation
| order by ["Avg CPU %"] asc
content.title: Step 2a · Right-sizing via Perf counters  (downsize when Avg CPU & Avg Mem both < threshold)

content.query:
let cpuThreshold = {CPUThreshold};
let cpu = InsightsMetrics
| where Origin == "vm.azm.ms" and Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage"
| summarize AvgCPU = round(avg(Val), 1), P95CPU = round(percentile(Val, 95), 1), MaxCPU = round(max(Val), 1) by Computer;
let mem = InsightsMetrics
| where Origin == "vm.azm.ms" and Namespace == "Memory" and Name == "AvailableMB"
| summarize AvgAvailGB = round(avg(Val) / 1024, 2), MinAvailGB = round(min(Val) / 1024, 2) by Computer;
cpu
| join kind=leftouter (mem) on Computer
| extend Recommendation = case(
    AvgCPU < cpuThreshold, "Downsize candidate",
    P95CPU >= 80, "Consider upsizing",
    "Right-sized")
| project Computer, ["Avg CPU %"] = AvgCPU, ["P95 CPU %"] = P95CPU, ["Max CPU %"] = MaxCPU, ["Avg Avail Mem (GB)"] = AvgAvailGB, ["Min Avail Mem (GB)"] = MinAvailGB, Recommendation
| order by ["Avg CPU %"] asc
content.title: Step 2b · Right-sizing via VM Insights / InsightsMetrics  (downsize when Avg CPU < threshold; verify memory via available GB)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
    (Perf | where ObjectName in ("Processor", "Processor Information") and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total" | project Computer, CPU = CounterValue),
    (InsightsMetrics | where Origin == "vm.azm.ms" and Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage" | project Computer, CPU = Val)
| summarize ["Avg CPU %"] = round(avg(CPU), 1) by Computer
| top 20 by ["Avg CPU %"] asc
content.title: Top 20 least-utilized VMs (by Avg CPU)

content.query:
let cpuThreshold = {CPUThreshold};
let memThreshold = {MemThreshold};
let cpu = union isfuzzy=true
    (Perf | where ObjectName in ("Processor", "Processor Information") and CounterName == "% Processor Time" and InstanceName == "_Total" | project Computer, CPU = CounterValue),
    (InsightsMetrics | where Origin == "vm.azm.ms" and Namespace == "Processor" and Name == "UtilizationPercentage" | project Computer, CPU = Val)
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CPU), P95CPU = percentile(CPU, 95) by Computer;
let mem = Perf
| where ObjectName == "Memory" and CounterName in ("% Committed Bytes In Use", "% Used Memory")
| summarize AvgMem = avg(CounterValue), P95Mem = percentile(CounterValue, 95) by Computer;
cpu
| join kind=leftouter (mem) on Computer
| extend Recommendation = case(
    AvgCPU < cpuThreshold and (isempty(AvgMem) or AvgMem < memThreshold), "Downsize candidate",
    P95CPU >= 80 or P95Mem >= 80, "Consider upsizing",
    "Right-sized")
| summarize Count = count() by Recommendation
content.title: Fleet recommendation distribution
